backup.production_rule: Adds two new functions and nothing else: no table, column, row, policy or existing function changes. The backup is still the last act before the apply (D-210, D-217.6).

forward_verification.name: both_task_functions_exist_and_are_definer
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('system_task_open_v1', 'system_task_close_missing_v1') and p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']

forward_verification.name: only_service_role_may_call_them
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.system_task_open_v1(uuid, text, text, text, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.system_task_close_missing_v1(text, text[], text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.system_task_open_v1(uuid, text, text, text, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.system_task_open_v1(uuid, text, text, text, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.system_task_close_missing_v1(text, text[], text, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.system_task_close_missing_v1(text, text[], text, text)', 'EXECUTE')

forward_verification.name: a_job_task_closes_only_its_own_system_rows
forward_verification.query: select p.prosrc like '%idempotency_key like ''system:%''%' and p.prosrc like '%source_ref >= p_since%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'system_task_close_missing_v1'

forward_verification.name: applying_this_release_created_no_task
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from public.follow_up_tasks where idempotency_key like 'system:%'

rollback.safe_until: until turnover-verifier and missed-cleaning-alert are redeployed from waves cbf2dd4 - they call these functions. Roll the functions back first (redeploy from ce4a8f3), then drop the two functions.

steps.name: drop_the_two_functions
steps.action: run-sql-on-host.sh a file containing: begin; drop function if exists public.system_task_open_v1(uuid, text, text, text, text, text); drop function if exists public.system_task_close_missing_v1(text, text[], text, text); commit;

feature_flags.name: nothing_calls_them_until_the_functions_deploy
feature_flags.required_state: turnover-verifier and missed-cleaning-alert from waves cbf2dd4 are the only callers; deploy them AFTER this release, never before, or their runs fail with 'function does not exist'.

compatibility.evidence: Two new service_role-only definer functions writing follow_up_tasks, which service_role cannot touch directly since the operational RLS lockdown. pgTAP system_tasks.sql: idempotency, refusal of a malformed kind, close only when no longer reported and only inside the window, never close a person's own task.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty
the rehearsal has not run system_tasks.sql green on this commit
